results.title: AccountsIQ and Abacum Partner to Launch AI-Powered Finance Stack for Mid-Market Businesses
results.content:
## Quick Summary

AccountsIQ and Abacum have formed a strategic partnership to provide mid-market businesses with an integrated AI-powered finance stack. By combining cloud accounting with advanced FP&A tools, the collaboration eliminates manual spreadsheets, enabling automated real-time financial forecasting and multi-entity consolidation for over 35,000 global users.
